Question: In the BLS QCEW fourth-quarter 2024 data for Mississippi, what was the December 2024 private-sector employment level, in covered jobs, for NAICS 23 Construction?

A. 51,371 covered jobs
B. 40,968 covered jobs

Source citation: BLS QCEW Open Data, Mississippi statewide, 2024 Q4 (https://data.bls.gov/cew/data/api/2024/4/area/28000.csv)

Supplied draft answer: B
